**What’s the email address on your account?**

I can help update your address—but I’ll still need to **authenticate you** first.

Since you don’t remember your email, please tell me:
1) **First name**  
2) **Last name**  
3) **ZIP code**

Also—about the “cheapest t-shirt”: I can tell you the lowest current price once we confirm which **t-shirt product option(s)** are available in the store, but I’ll need to look up the product catalog first. Do you want **any t-shirt** (any color/size), or do you have a preferred **size**?

Ah, you caught me—I gave you my new Phoenix zip, but my account is probably still sunbathing in Florida! The old ZIP code is 32169. Hopefully that helps you find me—my account is probably still wearing flip-flops.

As for the t-shirt, I’m not picky! Any color, any size that would fit a grown-up who loves pizza and puns. Just looking for the absolute cheapest option—my sense of humor is big, but my budget is small!
